evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing — inpatient (入院) receipt basic information editing for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCR0620 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates and edits basic inpatient (入院) receipt information. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE61–RECE69, RECE67) containing receipt and insurance history data, applying complex Japanese medical insurance rules (公費, 高齢者, 生保, etc.). The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002–2012 covering numerous insurance system reforms.

notable_features: Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based persistence only
255 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Long revision history (2002–2012) with named developers (NACL team)
Fixed-format source with some lines exceeding column 72
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (appears garbled in latin-1 view). This is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 215KB / 4562 lines. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/medical calculation program — likely uses DISPLAY numerics or relies on copybook definitions not shown.
